[A celebrated Prince of the lunar race, who is usually styled Vatsarāja. He reigned at Kauśāmbī. Vāsavadattā, Princess of Ujjayinī, saw him in a dream and fell in love with him. Udayana is the hero of the play called Ratnāvalī and his life has been made the subject of several other minor compositions. See Vatsa also].
